{{Top|leg}}
'''Fish cakes''' were fried delicacies enjoyed by [[Sentience/Legends|beings]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Merratt Jaxton]] was fond of [[Fish/Legends|fish]] cakes, and helped himself to a great many of them while being entertained at the estate of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Drikl Lecersen]].
